# Compass

> MongoDB Compass is a GUI for querying, aggregating, and analyzing your data in a visual environment run on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

- [Add Validation Rules](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/add-validation-rules.md)
- [Aggregation Pipeline Builder Settings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/agg-pipeline-builder/aggregation-pipeline-builder-settings.md): Adjust MongoDB Compass Aggregation Pipeline Builder settings to customize your experience and enhance pipeline performance.
- [Count Pipeline Results Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/agg-pipeline-builder/count-pipeline-results.md): View the number of documents outputted by your aggregation pipeline using the count results button in MongoDB Compass.
- [Create a View from Pipeline Results](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/agg-pipeline-builder/create-a-view.md): Create a read-only view from aggregation pipeline results in MongoDB Compass to limit user access to predefined data.
- [Export Aggregation Pipeline Results](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/agg-pipeline-builder/export-pipeline-results.md): Export your aggregation pipeline results from Compass as JSON or CSV files, with options for advanced JSON formats to preserve data types.
- [Export Pipeline to Specific Language](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/agg-pipeline-builder/export-pipeline-to-language.md): Export aggregation pipelines to various programming languages using the Aggregation Pipeline Builder for integration into applications.
- [Set Max Time MS for Aggregation Queries](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/agg-pipeline-builder/maxtime-ms-pipeline.md): Set an upper time limit for aggregation pipelines in MongoDB Compass using the Max Time MS option to manage query execution time.
- [Open a Saved Pipeline](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/agg-pipeline-builder/open-saved-pipeline.md): Load and edit saved aggregation pipelines in MongoDB Compass using the pipeline builder.
- [Specify Custom Collation For Your Pipeline](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/agg-pipeline-builder/pipeline-custom-collation.md): Specify custom collation in your aggregation pipeline to apply language-specific string comparison rules, such as case and accent handling.
- [Save a Pipeline](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/agg-pipeline-builder/save-agg-pipeline.md): Save your aggregation pipelines for future use and edit them without altering the original version.
- [View Explain Plans for a Pipeline](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/agg-pipeline-builder/view-pipeline-explain-plan.md): View the explain plan for your aggregation pipeline to understand its performance, including execution time and document examination details.
- [AI and Data Usage Information](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/ai-and-data-usage-information.md): Understand how natural language querying in Compass and the MongoDB assistant use Generative AI and how your data is handled and protected.
- [Manage Collections in Compass](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/collections.md): How to create or drop a collection, which is a grouping of MongoDB documents equivalent to a table in a relational database system.
- [Create a Clustered Collection](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/collections/clustered-collection.md): Create a clustered collection with a clustered index on the `_id` field, and optionally set a TTL index for automatic document expiration.
- [Create a Collection with Collation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/collections/collation-collection.md): Create a collection with collation to specify language-specific string comparison rules, including locale selection and optional parameters.
- [Create a Collection with Queryable Encryption](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/collections/encrypted-collection.md): Create a collection with Queryable Encryption in MongoDB 7.0 or later, allowing encryption of specific fields with equality queries.
- [Create a Time Series Collection](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/collections/time-series-collection.md): Create a time series collection to efficiently store sequences of measurements over time, specifying fields like `timeField` and optional metadata.
- [Connect Compass to MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect.md): How to use MongoDB Compass to connect to a MongoDB standalone, replica set, or sharded cluster host.
- [Advanced Connection Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/advanced-connection-options.md): Explore advanced connection options in Compass, including authentication, TLS/SSL, SSH, and Queryable Encryption for secure MongoDB deployment connections.
- [Advanced Connection Tab](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/advanced-connection-options/advanced-connection.md): Explore advanced connection options in Compass, including read preferences and additional fields like replica set name and URI options.
- [Authentication Connection Tab](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/advanced-connection-options/authentication-connection.md): Connect to deployments requiring authentication by selecting from various methods like Username/Password, OIDC, X.509, Kerberos, LDAP, or AWS IAM.
- [General Connection Tab](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/advanced-connection-options/general-connection.md): Configure connection string schemes and hostnames to connect to MongoDB deployments using the General connection tab in Compass.
- [In-Use Encryption Connection Tab](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/advanced-connection-options/in-use-encryption.md): Connect deployments with Queryable Encryption using the In-Use Encryption tab, specifying a Key Vault Namespace and selecting a KMS provider.
- [Proxy / SSH Tunnel Connection Tab](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/advanced-connection-options/ssh-connection.md): Connect to your deployment using a Proxy method or SSH tunnel with options for SSH with password, SSH with identity file, Socks5, or application-level proxy.
- [TLS / SSL Connection Tab](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/advanced-connection-options/tls-ssl-connection.md): Configure TLS/SSL settings for secure connections in the MongoDB Compass TLS/SSL tab, with options for certificate validation and security settings.
- [Start Compass from the Command Line](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/connect-from-the-command-line.md): Start a MongoDB Compass session from the command line using a connection string or configuration file for easier deployment in enterprise environments.
- [Connections Sidebar](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/connections.md)
- [Disconnect from MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/disconnect.md): Disconnect from a MongoDB deployment in Compass by selecting "Disconnect" from the Connect menu.
- [Favorite Connections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/favorite-connections.md): Save and manage favorite MongoDB connection configurations in Compass for easy reconnection to deployments.
- [Export Saved Connections with the CLI](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/favorite-connections/import-export-cli/export.md): Export saved MongoDB Compass connections using the CLI, with options to encrypt the exported file for security.
- [Import Saved Connections with the CLI](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/favorite-connections/import-export-cli/import.md): Import saved connections in MongoDB Compass using the CLI, with options for encrypted and unencrypted files.
- [Export Saved Connections in Compass](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/favorite-connections/import-export-ui/export.md): Export saved connections in MongoDB Compass as a JSON file, with options to encrypt sensitive information.
- [Import Saved Connections in Compass](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/favorite-connections/import-export-ui/import.md): Import saved connections in MongoDB Compass from a JSON file to use connections from other workspaces or team members.
- [Export and Import Saved Connections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/favorite-connections/import-export.md): Export and import saved connections in MongoDB Compass using the UI or CLI, with options to encrypt sensitive information.
- [Required Access](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/connect/required-access.md): Understand the specific privileges required for MongoDB Compass users to access various features when authentication/authorization is enforced.
- [Create an Aggregation Pipeline](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/create-agg-pipeline.md): Create aggregation pipelines in MongoDB Compass using visual or text-based modes to process and return computed results from collections.
- [Data Modeling in MongoDB Compass](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/data-modeling.md): Plan and visualize your schema with the Data Modeling experience in Compass.
- [Export Your Entity-Relationship Diagram from Compass](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/data-modeling/export-diagram.md): Export an entity-relationship diagram from Compass as a diagram file, PNG image, or JSON file.
- [Generate an Entity-Relationship Diagram in Compass](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/data-modeling/generate-diagram.md): Create an entity-relationship diagram in MongoDB Compass.
- [Import an Entity-Relationship Diagram in Compass](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/data-modeling/import-diagram.md): Import an entity-relationship diagram into Compass from a .mdm file.
- [Modify Collections in Your Compass Entity-Relationship Diagram](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/data-modeling/modify-collections.md): Modify collection information in your Compass entity-relationship diagram.
- [Modify Fields in Your Compass Entity-Relationship Diagram](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/data-modeling/modify-fields.md): Modify fields in your Compass entity-relationship diagram.
- [Manage Relationships in Your Compass Entity-Relationship Diagram](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/data-modeling/relationships.md): Manually add, modify, and delete relationships between fields in your Compass entity-relationship diagram.
- [Manage Databases in Compass](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/databases.md): Manage databases in Compass by creating or dropping them, and view collections within each database.
- [Manage Documents in Compass](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/documents.md): Manage documents in Compass by viewing, inserting, modifying, cloning, and deleting them within a MongoDB collection.
- [Clone Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/documents/clone.md): Clone documents in MongoDB Compass by copying the schema and values of an existing document, then edit and insert the new document.
- [Delete Multiple Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/documents/delete-multiple.md): Perform bulk delete operations on multiple documents in Compass using the Delete Documents modal to visualize and confirm deletions.
- [Delete Single Document](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/documents/delete.md): Delete single or multiple documents in MongoDB Compass using the UI or the embedded MongoDB Shell.
- [Insert Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/documents/insert.md): Insert documents into collections in MongoDB Compass using JSON Mode or a Field-by-Field Editor.
- [Modify Multiple Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/documents/modify-multiple.md): Perform update operations on multiple documents in Compass using the update documents modal to visualize changes before applying them.
- [Modify Single Document](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/documents/modify.md): Edit existing documents in Compass using findOneAndUpdate or findOneAndReplace operations based on the view mode.
- [View Documents in Compass](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/documents/view.md): Explore different ways to view, expand, and copy documents in MongoDB Compass, including handling encrypted fields.
- [Edit Validation Rules](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/edit-validation-rules.md)
- [Capabilities of Compass Editions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/editions.md): Explore the feature chart to choose the best MongoDB Compass edition for your needs, comparing capabilities like CRUD functionality and query performance.
- [Embedded MongoDB Shell](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/embedded-shell.md): Access and use the embedded `mongosh` shell in MongoDB Compass to test queries and operations, or disable it for security.
- [Export Query to Specific Language](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/export-query-to-language.md): Export queries from MongoDB Compass to various programming languages for integration into your application.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/faq.md): Find answers to common questions about MongoDB Compass, including performance impact, handling of confidential data, and troubleshooting feature issues.
- [Generate Validation Rules](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/generate-validation-rules.md)
- [Import and Export Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/import-export.md): Learn how to import, export, and format data from collections with MongoDB Compass. MongoDB Compass supports both JSON and CSV file types.
- [In-Use Encryption Tutorial](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/in-use-encryption-tutorial.md): Learn how to connect to deployments using Queryable Encryption to encrypt specific fields in your collections with MongoDB Compass.
- [What is MongoDB Compass?](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/index.md): MongoDB Compass is a GUI for querying, aggregating, and analyzing your data in a visual environment run on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
- [Manage Indexes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/indexes.md): Manage indexes to improve query performance by creating, hiding, or dropping them, and explore options like unique, TTL, and wildcard indexes.
- [Create and Manage a MongoDB Search Index](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/indexes/create-search-index.md): Create and manage MongoDB Search indexes in MongoDB Compass to enable efficient text search queries by mapping search terms to documents.
- [Create a MongoDB Vector Search Index](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/indexes/create-vector-search-index.md): Create MongoDB Vector Search indexes in MongoDB Compass to enable semantic searches by indexing vector data and other data types.
- [Download and Install Compass](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/install.md): Download and install MongoDB Compass for Windows, macOS, or Linux.
- [Verify Integrity of Compass Packages](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/install/verify-signatures.md): Verify the integrity of MongoDB Compass packages using digital signatures before installation.
- [Verify Packages with Disk Image Verification](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/install/verify-signatures/disk-images.md): Verify MongoDB Compass `.dmg` packages on macOS using digital signatures to ensure they are valid and unaltered.
- [Verify Packages with GPG](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/install/verify-signatures/gpg.md): Verify MongoDB Compass packages using GPG to ensure they are valid and unaltered before installation.
- [Verify RPM Packages (RHEL)](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/install/verify-signatures/rpm.md): Verify the digital signatures of MongoDB Compass RPM packages on RHEL to ensure they are valid and unaltered before installation.
- [Verify Windows Packages](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/install/verify-signatures/windows.md): Verify the digital signatures of MongoDB Compass Windows packages using PowerShell or by checking the package properties to ensure authenticity.
- [Compass Home](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/instance.md): Access details about MongoDB instances connected through Compass, including managing multiple connections and viewing saved queries and pipelines.
- [Keyboard Shortcuts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/keyboard-shortcuts.md): Explore keyboard shortcuts in Compass for efficient navigation and operation, including commands for menu actions, general tasks, and web shell interactions.
- [Resources to Learn and Explore MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/learn-more.md): Explore free online courses, resources, and community forums to learn MongoDB basics, best practices, and advanced features.
- [Interact with Your Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/manage-data.md): Explore and manage your data in MongoDB Compass, including creating databases, managing collections, querying data, and analyzing schema and performance.
- [Performance Insights](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/manage-data/performance-insights.md): Improve your schema and data modeling practices with performance insights from MongoDB Compass to enhance application performance.
- [View Real-Time Performance](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/performance.md): Access real-time server performance stats in MongoDB Compass, including operations, network, memory, and the ability to stop slow operations.
- [View Query Performance](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/query-plan.md): Analyze query performance by viewing the explain plan in MongoDB Compass, which includes execution time, returned documents, and examined index keys.
- [Query with Natural Language](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/query-with-natural-language.md): Explore how to use natural language in MongoDB Compass to generate filter queries and aggregations with AI assistance.
- [Intelligent Assistant in Compass](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/query-with-natural-language/compass-ai-assistant.md)
- [Enable Natural Language Querying](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/query-with-natural-language/enable-natural-language-querying.md): Enable natural language querying in Compass by toggling the Use Generative AI setting.
- [Prompt a Natural Language Aggregation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/query-with-natural-language/prompt-natural-language-aggregation.md): Generate aggregation queries in MongoDB Compass using natural language prompts to assist in learning query writing.
- [Prompt a Natural Language Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/query-with-natural-language/prompt-natural-language-query.md): Use MongoDB Compass to generate queries with natural language prompts, leveraging AI to assist in writing MongoDB queries.
- [Run Atlas Search Queries](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/query/atlas-search.md): Run Atlas Search queries using aggregation pipeline stages like `$search`, `$searchMeta`, and `$vectorSearch` in MongoDB Compass.
- [Set Language Specific Rules for String Comparison](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/query/collation.md): Specify language-specific rules for string comparison using the Collation query bar option in MongoDB Compass.
- [Query Your Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/query/filter.md): Use Compass to query documents in your Atlas, Enterprise, or Community database deployments.
- [Limit the Number of Returned Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/query/limit.md): Specify a limit on the number of documents returned in a query using the Limit option in the Query Bar.
- [Adjust Maximum Time for Query Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/query/maxtimems.md): Adjust the MAX TIME MS setting in Compass to set a time limit for query operations, ensuring they don't exceed a specified duration.
- [Set Which Fields Are Returned](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/query/project.md): Specify which fields to return in query results using the Project option in MongoDB Compass.
- [Manage Saved Queries in Compass](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/query/queries.md): Learn how to save a pipeline for later use in MongoDB Compass. Additionally, understand how to add and view favorite saved queries.
- [View Recent Queries](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/query/recent.md): Access and manage up to 20 recent queries in the query bar, with options to save, copy, or remove them.
- [Skip a Number of Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/query/skip.md): Specify how many documents to skip in a query using the Skip option in MongoDB Compass.
- [Sort the Returned Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/query/sort.md): How to use Compass to specify the sort order of the returned documents in your Atlas, Enterprise, or Community database deployment.
- [Release Notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/release-notes.md): Explore the latest features, bug fixes, and improvements in MongoDB Compass with detailed release notes for each version.
- [Sampling](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/sampling.md): Explore how MongoDB Compass uses sampling to efficiently analyze a subset of documents from a collection.
- [Analyze Your Data Schema](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/schema.md): Explore and analyze a collection's data schema using the Schema tab, which provides insights into data types, field contents, and allows for query filtering.
- [Export Your Schema](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/schema/export.md): Export your analyzed schema as a JSON object in MongoDB Compass to share and compare schemas across collections.
- [Customize Compass](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/settings.md): Customize MongoDB Compass settings to manage user access, privacy, and automate configurations using the interface, command line, or configuration files.
- [Command Line Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/settings/command-line-options.md): Customize MongoDB Compass using command line options to set configuration settings at startup, which cannot be modified in the Compass interface.
- [Configuration File Settings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/settings/config-file.md): Customize MongoDB Compass settings at startup using a configuration file in EJSON or YAML format, specifying options like auto-updates and UI theme.
- [Display Legacy UUID Values](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/settings/display-legacy-uuid-values.md)
- [Toggle Chrome DevTools](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/settings/enable-dev-tools.md): Enable or disable Chrome DevTools in MongoDB Compass to access additional diagnostic or debugging information.
- [Secure Your Connection String](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/settings/protect-connection-strings.md): Enable the `protectConnectionStrings` option in MongoDB Compass to secure credentials in your connection string.
- [Restrict Write Operations to MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/settings/read-only.md): Enable the `readOnly` option in MongoDB Compass to prevent users from performing write operations.
- [Block Outgoing Network Connections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/settings/restrict-outgoing-connections.md): Configure MongoDB Compass to block outgoing network connections by disabling the `networkTraffic` option via command line or configuration file.
- [Set Default Sort Order](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/settings/set-default-sort.md)
- [Interface Settings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/settings/settings-reference.md): Customize MongoDB Compass interface settings, including read-only mode, theme preferences, and proxy configurations.
- [Display the Kerberos Password Field](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/settings/show-kerberos-password.md): Enable the `showKerberosPasswordField` option in Compass to display the Kerberos password field for authentication.
- [Specify Read Preference and Tags](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/settings/specify-read-preference-tags.md): Set read preferences and tags in MongoDB Compass to control how users connect and perform read operations on your deployment.
- [Configure Telemetry Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/settings/telemetry.md)
- [Submit Feedback](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/submit-feedback.md): Submit feedback, report bugs, or request features for MongoDB Compass through JIRA or the MongoDB Feedback Engine.
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/troubleshooting.md): Find solutions for troubleshooting MongoDB Compass, including retrieving logs and resolving connection issues.
- [Compass Connection Errors](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/troubleshooting/connection-errors.md): Troubleshoot common connection errors in MongoDB Compass with solutions for issues like incorrect hostnames, firewall blocks, and authentication failures.
- [Retrieve Compass Logs](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/troubleshooting/logs.md): Access and view MongoDB Compass logs to diagnose errors, with logs stored in a structured JSON format and retained for 30 days.
- [Update MongoDB Compass](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/upgrade.md): Upgrade MongoDB Compass by manually installing the latest version or enabling automatic updates to access new features and improvements.
- [Set Validation Rules for Your Schema](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/validation.md): Manage schema validation rules for a collection using JSON Schema or query expressions to ensure documents conform to specified rules.
- [Manage Views in Compass](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/views.md): Manage views in Compass by creating, opening, duplicating, modifying, and dropping views using the Aggregation Pipeline Builder.
